apps.name: GrandStand
apps.subtitle: Live sport, TV, movies and replays
apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes streams going black (and cricket links cycling) after the app had been in the background: no need to close and reopen it any more. New: split screen (two games side by side, or one in the corner) and picture-in-picture you can browse the app under.
First iPhone & iPad version: live sport, Live TV, Twitch, replays, and movies & TV with TorBox.
